objective: Close Wave 2 photo retention/source policy: keeping a photo in the Brain must retain only metadata and a stable link back to Photos, never duplicate the original image/video.

criteria.promise: A kept photo projects into the graph as a source-linked metadata node with a stable Photos target, not as a copied file path or binary attachment.
The launcher/action path for photos.remember is guarded by explicit confirmation and reports a clear failure when the selected asset is no longer available.
Focused tests cover the retention/source contract without requiring Photos runtime permission or a real photo library.

verification_gates.procedure: Inspect Capture.photo, PhotoItem, WorkGraph/Photo tests, and any changed code.
verification_gates.expected: Photo graph nodes use bel://photos/<assetID>, metadata detail, and no source image path copy.

verification_gates.procedure: Inspect AppDelegate photos.remember dispatch/confirmation and result action catalog.
verification_gates.expected: photos.remember requires confirmation and missing asset reports an actionable failure before graph write.

verification_gates.procedure: Run swift test --filter PhotoTests and swift test --filter CaptureWiringTests plus git diff --check on scoped files.
verification_gates.expected: Focused tests pass and do not depend on Photos.framework runtime state.

recon_evidence: PhotoActionHandler, Capture.photo, AppDelegate photos.remember, PhotoTests, and WorkGraphTests were inspected. The runtime Photos library remains a manual integration gate; this ticket verifies the product retention contract without copying originals.

first_checkpoint.evidence: A focused diff or no-op proof showing the metadata-only photo retention path and missing-asset guard.
